titleEn: QR codes and barcodes for the store and products

ar: اطبع ملصق فيه باركود و QR للمنتج
en: How do I print a QR code for my store?
Print a label with a barcode and a product QR

edgeCases: Combined barcode + QR product label (label settings, Codes screen only, not an assistant tool): the QR links to the product page on the store's own domain (custom domain when active, else <slug>.ebda.app); both codes keep a scannable minimum size; on a label too small for both (A4 5x13, or a very long custom domain on the smallest rolls) the page refuses with a message offering a bigger label or one code only
QR scans recorded on DO stores had a P0 bug (#752 open)
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Plan/feature not allowing it: API returns 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with an upgrade target when the plan is the cause; assistant must name the plan and link Billing, never imply a toggle
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: Analytics of QR scans broken on DO stores until #752 merges
